title: 2006 Upper Deck #7 John Elway Denver Broncos Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This John Elway trading card is a must-have for any Denver Broncos fan. Featuring the legendary quarterback in his 2006 Upper Deck Legends card, this sports trading card is a great addition to any collection. The card is in its original state and has not been autographed or signed by John Elway.

The card is part of the base set and has the card number #7. It was manufactured by Upper Deck in the United States and is from the 2006 season. This item is perfect for collectors or fans of John Elway and the Denver Broncos.
